name: BAHW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's own top prize, already held by Rick "The Reaper" Erickson at the held record's earliest surviving card and defended by him through every subsequent show this pass has read.
notes: Reign-by-reign lineage before this collection's own earliest card is not recoverable.

name: BAHW United States Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at the fed's own founding-era supercard, Hardcore Haven, when Chimera dethroned the reigning "Paralizer" Patrick Bordeau.
notes: Bordeau's own prior reign predates this collection's earliest surviving card; no won-date recovered for it.

name: BAHW Television Championship
epitaph: Crowned for the first time in this collection's own holdings at Hardcore Haven, when "The Perfectionist" Nik Nyce won a lengthy tournament final; defended successfully one week later.

name: BAHW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at Hardcore Haven when El Jaguar defeated The Ring Assassin; vacated at some point before a new tournament final is referenced in the held record's May 1997 holdings.
notes: The gap between El Jaguar's win and the May 1997 tournament final referenced in a later show is not receipted -- an honest gap, not a silent thinning.
